summary: AI tools are welcome for PRs. Say when a significant part of the code is AI-generated, own and explain every line, and get approval in an issue before significant changes.

evidence.quote: We welcome the use of AI tools for authoring PRs
Be transparent: If a significant portion of your code is AI generated, please indicate that in your PR description.
Be accountable: You are responsible for the code you submit, regardless of whether it was generated by AI or written by you.
